description: Use this when you want to transpose chords or change the key of a song. Accepts a sheet up to 12,000 characters, chords above lyrics or ChordPro brackets; choose semitones -11 to +11, from_key with to_key, or capo_fret 0 to 9. Returns key change, chord mapping, widget sheet and a monospaced PDF. Chord names only; does not process audio, tablature or staff notation. Key estimates can be wrong for songs that change key.

capo_fret.description: Capo fret from 0 to 9; for example 2 returns shapes two semitones below the sounding key. Use this instead of semitones or to_key.

from_key.description: Origin key; for example C or Am. Required with to_key; otherwise the header or first and last chords give a key estimate.

semitones.description: Signed shift from -11 to +11; for example 2 moves up two semitones. Give one transposition choice.

sheet.description: Chord sheet of 1 to 12,000 characters, with chords above lyrics or inline; for example C    G\nLanterns glow, or [Am]Lantern [F]garden.

spelling.description: Chord spelling; for example auto follows the target key, while sharps forces F# instead of Gb for consistent round trips.

title.description: PDF title up to 80 characters; for example Lantern Garden.

to_key.description: Target key paired with from_key; for example from_key C and to_key F. Use this instead of semitones or capo_fret.

name: transpose_chords
title: Transpose chords
